assembly_digest_method: SHA-256 over ordered canonical lines '<path>:<git_blob_sha>\n' for the assembly components in order, then the output contract
change_summary: Consolidation only. The seven-document assembly is replaced by one runtime document. No professional rule was added, removed, relaxed or re-scoped; duplicates collapse to one statement, four cross-document conflicts are resolved in favour of the stricter formulation, four dead dependencies on the pre-v0.4 prose regime are removed, and 21 closed-vocabulary members that existed only in the frozen output contract and the frozen oracle are now documented for the candidate. Equivalence is proven mechanically by test_consolidation_equivalence_v10.py.
qualification_scope: fresh post-freeze held-out qualification cycle; NOT library-admitted until a valid gate passes.
freeze_rules: Do not edit the candidate, output contract, generator, grader, fixture contract or thresholds during this cycle.
Held-out cases are generated after this freeze from the preregistered seed.
Graders may not be broadened to accept an observed output. Construct repairs require a recorded burn and a fresh seed.
Any behavioral failure ends the cycle; repair requires a new candidate version and a new freeze.
known_limits: Equivalence is proven at the level of rule presence, modality and vocabulary completeness. It does not establish that the model behaves correctly; only a fresh held-out gate can.
The two residual v0.8 failure modes are locked by regression at the detection level only, for the same reason.
